products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI platform that describes itself as "the world's most powerful creative AI suite," offering tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. The platform aggregates a wide range of third-party frontier models alongside its own, including video models from ByteDance, MiniMax, Google, and Alibaba, as well as image models from providers such as Qwen and FLUX.

Krea's own model, Krea 2, is described as its first foundation image model built from scratch, with a focus on aesthetics, style transfer, and creative control. The company notes that Contra Labs benchmarked Krea 2 Large within 0.14 points of GPT Image 2 on Style Fidelity in a four-model style-transfer benchmark. The platform also provides access to models such as MiniMax's Hailuo for 2K video generation, Google's Veo for video-first multimodal output, and ByteDance's Seedance family for cinematic video clips with native synchronized audio, with the site indicating that generation is available for free.

The held facts record one tracked product, Krea AI, categorized under video generation and editing, with notes describing it as a real-time video generation and creative tool. No litigation, MCP server presence, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company.
